ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution featuring a high-intensity white to low-intensity black ratio of approximately 1:4 across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black region in the central and lower fluke quadrants. High-intensity white contiguous blobs are localized at the distal tips of both lobes. Significant white mottling and diffuse speckling present along the upper trailing edge margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated vertex angle of 45-50 degrees and a vertical depth of approximately 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing boundary with high-frequency pixel-amplitude variations forming jagged peaks and shallow valleys between the notch and tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curve originating from the fluke base and terminating in acute-angled distal tips; concave sweep observed along the trailing edge from the median notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-relief pixel groupings (barnacle colonies) localized on the extreme distal tips. Isolated circular low-intensity centered white rings (cookie-cutter type scars) detected on the medial right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-contrast linear pixel disruptions present on both lobes; a complex network of intersecting diagonal and vertical white rake marks is prominent on the lower-left lobe, including a distinct X-shaped crossing.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive cetacean rake marks (linear abrasions) across the ventral surface and heavy calcified barnacle encrustation on the terminal lobe tips.
